verdict.rationale: Ledgy's marketing pages say users can grant share awards in bulk and run granting, document and signature workflows in bulk. That is a first-party bulk capability, but only for equity-grant workflows, and it is described in marketing copy without operational detail. The documented API surface (auth, companyCaptable, companyTransactions with paging and delta reads) appears read-only, with no bulk write or mutation operations. missing for 10: programmatic/API bulk operations an AI-native user could drive, bulk actions beyond grants/documents/signatures, detailed docs on bulk limits or behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Grant share awards one by one, or in bulk, creating, signing and sharing contracts in just a few clicks.
